title: cal issues --json
description: Recurring errors over the last 180 days, most frequent first, each with the sessions that hit it and, once a linked commit fixed it, the fix and its playbook.

schema_version.description: Major version of this payload's shape. A reader refuses a version newer than it knows.

results.description: The rows, best match (or newest) first.

notice.description:
Present only when `results` is empty because this machine couldn't run the query (no
embedding model for `decisions` / `gotchas`), so a reader can tell that from no match.

example.description:
A representative raw error line (the latest raw sighting: candidates are read newest
first and the first line seen for a signature is kept).

count.description: How many messages this error appeared in (≈ times you hit it).

threadIds.description: The sessions that hit it, newest sighting first (at most 10).

fix.description:
The commit that fixed it, null while none is known. Scoped to a project, the newest fix
made there (a fix in another project is left out); unscoped, the fix in the project of
the latest sighting, else the newest in any project.

playbook.description:
The playbook gotcha recorded for that fix in its project (`extractor = 'playbook'`),
null when there is none or the user deleted it.

Issue.description:
A recurring error with its sessions and, once a commit fixed it, the fix and the playbook
line: what `cal issues --json-version 1`, MCP `recurring_issues` and the app return.

threadId.description: The session that hit the error and made the fix.

IssueFix.description:
The commit that fixed a recurring error in one project: the latest session there that hit
it, then edited the file its error named and committed a change to that file.
